id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Tree-shaped 'hierarchy' rooted at a Root Complex, with optional Switches and Bridges; leaf nodes are Endpoints. Every PCIe Link is point-to-point and dual-simplex. At 32 GT/s the channel is loss-limited, so up to two protocol-aware retimers may be inserted per link. An Alternate Protocol (e.g. CXL) may be negotiated over the PCIe 5.0 PHY.

supported_topologies.name: RC + Switch + N Endpoints
supported_topologies.description: All ports at up to 32 GT/s.

supported_topologies.name: Link with retimers
supported_topologies.description: Up to two protocol-aware retimers to extend the 32 GT/s reach; each in the equalization handshake.

supported_topologies.name: Alternate-protocol link (CXL)
supported_topologies.description: Two devices negotiate CXL.io/CXL.cache/CXL.mem over the PCIe 5.0 PHY at 32 GT/s.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Top of one hierarchy; connects CPU/memory to PCIe fabric; must generate Configuration Requests as Requester; may generate I/O Requests; must not support Lock semantics as Completer.

Logical assembly of virtual PCI-to-PCI bridges; forwards TLPs unmodified; must not split a TLP into smaller TLPs; arbitrates between ingress ports on per-VC basis (round-robin or weighted round-robin).
Type 0 Configuration Space header; must support Configuration Requests as Completer; must NOT generate I/O Requests; must NOT support Lock semantics.
Type 0 header; may support I/O space + Lock semantics for legacy software compatibility; must not issue Locked Requests.
One PCIe Port + one or more PCI/PCI-X bus interfaces; supports Lock semantics from PCIe→PCI direction (for deadlock prevention).
Protocol-aware PHY extension device (up to two per link). Recovers clock/data, re-equalizes, retransmits; participates in the Phase 0-3 equalization handshake. Distinct from an analog-only redriver.

fields.interconnect_role: PCI Express 5.0 is a tree of point-to-point Links. Switches forward TLPs without dropping/splitting/reordering. Retimers extend electrical reach but are protocol-aware and transparent to transactions. TLP delivery is guaranteed per-Link by ACK/NAK + replay and optionally end-to-end by ECRC.

ordering_guarantees.producer_consumer: PCI / PCI-X compliant producer-consumer ordering model preserved end-to-end through Switches.
ordering_guarantees.relaxed_ordering_optin: TLPs may set the Relaxed Ordering attribute to opt out of certain strict ordering rules for performance.
ordering_guarantees.virtual_channel_isolation: Traffic on different VCs has no ordering relationship to traffic on other VCs; this enables traffic-class differentiation and prevents head-of-line blocking.
ordering_guarantees.completion_ordering: Completions returned to a Requester are NOT ordered against new Requests, allowing pipelining; ordering within a sequence of split-Completion fragments IS preserved.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Four address spaces: Memory (primary data path / DMA), I/O (legacy), Configuration (per-device control plane, 256 B + 4 KB extended incl. Lane Margining capability), Message (replaces sideband signals).

device_classification.root_complex: Connects CPU + memory to PCIe; one per hierarchy; up to 32 GT/s.
device_classification.switch: Aggregates N downstream ports into one upstream port.
device_classification.legacy_endpoint: PCI-compatible Endpoint; may use I/O space + Lock.
device_classification.retimer: Protocol-aware repeater (up to two per link) for 32 GT/s reach extension.
device_classification.cxl_device: Coherent accelerator / memory expander running CXL over the PCIe 5.0 PHY via Alternate Protocol Negotiation.
